Subject (in full) Propaganda in favour of Cosmopolitanism.
CHIV
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.
Copies of two pamphlets a translation of which
is as follows were found on Nanking Road in the Central
District at 8.20 p.m. January 5 :-
1. Slogans of the Chung Hwa National "Returing to
the Original State" Association :-
Adopt cosmopolitanism !
Genuine revolution is the work of the "Returning
to the Original State" Association !
Long live the "Returning to the Original State"
Association !
Cosmopolitanism is the very remedy against the
hardship and pain being sustained by peasants,
labourers, merchants and students.
Cosmopolitanism is the light to save the people.
Cosmopolitanism enforces equal treatment of human beings.
Let the youths of the whole nation come to the
path of cosmopolitanism.
Cosmopolitanism makes equal standing between the
rich and the poor.
Cosmopolitanism also protects the property of the
rich.
"The Returning to the Original State" Association
will lead you to a place where there is no worry.
Cosmopolitanism is absolutely necessary to solve
questions of clothing, food and shelter.
Let the brethren of the whole nation who wish to
evade being thrown out of employment join the
"Returning to the Original State" Association,
the organization of which is systematic and with

2. "A letter addressed to Labourers throughout the Country
by the Chung Hwa National "Returning to the Original
State" Association."
As a result of large quantities of commodities being
dumped into China the industry of the country has
suffered seriously. Most of the factories at various
localities closed while workers who are able to obtain
work in concerns which are still operating are working
curtailed shifts. What they earn is insufficient to
maintain their livelihood, yet the situation is growing
more serious day by day. The Association is quite
comprehensive of their sufferings and have meted out
measures to relieve them. They should either voluntarily
join the Association or organize a body of the same
nature, to struggle with the present nefarious Society,
beat down the Government, and lead the nationals to

If you want to take protection of the unemployed, it

If you have received the pain of being unemployed; or if

“返本”协会是一个将在中国建立的机构。

普遍主义是解决衣食住行问题的方案。

如果你希望获得对失业者的保护，建议加入“返本”协会，这是一个有体系的组织，拥有良好的记录和历史。

如果你遭受了失业的痛苦；或者担心你的财产缺乏保护；教育恶劣；缺衣少食；生病时无法得到医疗救治；或者年老时无人赡养；建议组织“返本”协会，以解决所有这些问题。

签署人：中国“返本”协会总部宣传科。

附注：结尾为一面黄色旗帜，中间有一个红色的“井”字。

2. 中国“返本”协会致中国劳工的一封信。

致最亲密的劳工们：

由于外国货物广泛进口到中国市场，中国工业受到极大影响。全国各地的几乎所有工厂都

pages.en:
the country have closed down. There are very few that are
continuing their business but are really facing a very hard
time. Labours employed in these factories cannot get work
daily, sometimes working two days in three and sometimes five
days in a week. Under such circumstances the wages that they
are earning are not even enough to support themselves. ~~There~~
How can they support their families? If it goes on like that
all the factories, we are sure, will close down in the near
future. And you will all receive the pain of being unemployed.
The future is so danger that none of you can maintain your
present position. Nearly all the capitalists in the present time
are very cruel in treating the labours. You must have received
their treatment already and know very well how they treat the
labours. According to the Law governing the factory the labours
are allowed to work 8 hours daily but actually they have to work
11 or 12 hours daily in nowadays. The working hour was so long,
the work is very hard and still if you make any mistake your will
receive a very severe punishment. Are you ready to receive such
treatment forever? The money which you earned under such circum-
stances was not even enough to solve the questions of food,
clothing and shelter of your family. How can you get money to
educate your children? Under such circumstances, apart from your-
selves passing the time in sorrow, the welfare of the children
is robbed too. So there will be no chance at all for you to
live a day in happiness. We are quite aware of your trouble and
for that purpose we have planned a very good plan which will
save you from the trouble. The plan is for you to join or to
organize the "Returning to the Beginning" Association. Then
you can fight with the evil environment surrounding you with
universalism. Universalism can put down the bad government
so that all the people can enjoy their life without poverty or
sorrow. Universalism can make everyone of you ~~the owners of the~~
~~factory~~ enjoy the welfare which the factory-owners are enjoying.
It is the important medicine to maintain your present position.
It can solve the questions of food, clothing, shelter and travel
pages.zh: 已关闭。仅有少数仍在继续经营，但也确实面临非常艰难的时期。受雇于这些工厂的劳工无法每天获得工作，有时三天工作两天，有时一周工作五天。在这种情况下，他们赚取的工资甚至不足以维持自身生存。~~那里~~ 他们如何养家糊口？如果这样持续下去，我们可以肯定，所有工厂在不久的将来都会关闭。而你们都将遭受失业的痛苦。未来如此危险，你们中没有人能维持目前的地位。当今几乎所有的资本家在对待劳工方面都非常残酷。你们一定已经受到了他们的待遇，并且非常清楚他们如何对待劳工。根据工厂管理法，劳工每天允许工作8小时，但实际上如今他们每天必须工作11或12小时。工作时间如此之长，工作非常辛苦，而且如果你犯任何错误，你将受到非常严厉的惩罚。你准备好永远接受这种待遇吗？在这种情况下赚取的金钱甚至不足以解决你家人的衣食住行问题。你哪里有钱来教育你的孩子？在这种情况下，除了你自己悲度时光外，孩子们的福利也被剥夺了。因此，你根本没有机会过上幸福的日子。我们完全了解你们的困境，为此我们制定了一个非常好的计划，将使你们摆脱困境。该计划就是让你们加入或组织“返本”协会。然后，你们可以用普遍主义与周围恶劣的环境作斗争。普遍主义可以推翻坏政府，使所有人都能享受没有贫困或悲伤的生活。普遍主义可以让你们每个人 ~~成为~~ ~~工厂主~~ 享受工厂主所享有的福利。这是维持你们目前地位的重要良药。它可以解决所有人的衣食住行和旅行

pages.en:
of all the people. It is the "Saviour" which will avoid
the sorrow of the people. In one word, universalism can
solve the question of living of the people and it can
make a nation rich and strong. Therefore it is hoped that
all of you who believe will come up and organize the
"Returning to the Beginning" Association and preach to your
friends and relatives to ask them to join the Association
so that China can be saved with universalism in the future.

Signed: Headquarters of the "Returning
to the Beginning" Association
of China.
